results.title: Akoijam to challenge JNU dismissal, lawyers to file case in 1-2 days
results.description: Congress MP Bimol Akoijam, who was dismissed from JNU following sexual harassment allegations, on Friday said his lawyers were preparing to challenge the action and would file a case in a day or two. A day after appearing before investigators at Delhi’s Vasant Kunj North Police Station in connection with the case, Akoijam returned to Imphal […] The post Akoijam to challenge JNU dismissal, lawyers to file case in 1-2 days first appeared on Nagaland Post.
